responsibility: This file implements RTL expansion of conditional control flow from tree expressions. It manages deferred stack-pop adjustments around jumps and emits compare-and-branch sequences for boolean expressions, integer and floating comparisons, split or multiword comparisons, bit tests, and canonicalized function-pointer comparisons, producing labels and jump insns used by statement and expression expansion.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for conditional-jump expansion in the `dojump` group: it emits compare-and-branch RTL and manages pending stack adjustments, while `gcc/dojump.h` only publishes the jump and stack-adjustment entry points.
